title: kalam_mogrt
description: RESERVED for Phase 6B (T6.14) — shape from kalam-prd.md §7.1 kalam_mogrt, FR-18, FR-19, §8; not routed yet. Upstream: adobe/tools/kalam/_upstream/jsx/host.jsx:166 KALAM.mogrt (entry kalam_mogrt :210). CEP WNC_KALAM.mogrt (signed bridge). Contract keys are snake_case; the port translates the upstream camelCase keys (docs/adobe/phase-6b-reservations.md). One MOGRT clip per caption on the chosen video track (importMGT at start + s, end at start + e, named 'Kalam <n>'), the text written into the template's text field. All-or-nothing (§8): any failure removes every clip placed so far and is an error. MOGRT text is not available in UXP before 27.0 (M1), so uxp is false.

mogrt_path.description: the .mogrt (FR-19 gallery or a file; upstream `mogrtPath`)

video_track.description: track index, 0-based (Premiere's DOM order; upstream error messages say V<index + 1>)

start.description: range start, sequence seconds; optional, default 0

text_param.description: the text field's display name; null or absent = the first real text field (FR-18; upstream `textParam`)

data.description: {mogrt_path,video_track,start?,text_param?,captions}: start and text_param stay optional to mirror upstream.

field.description: the text field written (its display name); null when no caption was placed

readback.description: {added,field}. The object stays open: keys the host adds are not rejected.
